q.g: In this quest you have to kill 3 of Reshala's followers and hand over 1 of their found in raid armors. You can hand over any of the following: * 6B43 Zabralo-Sh body armor (EMR) * BNTI Gzhel-K body armor * BNTI Zhuk body armor (EMR) * BNTI Zhuk body armor (EMR) * FORT Defender-2 body armor * FORT Redut-M body armor * NPP KlASS Korund-VM body armor (Black)
